text:
Maya Chen: Quick notes from today's design review — compact scorecard + approval flow. Hit a few small usability/accessibility friction points when approving an eval run in dense mode. TL;DR: focus order, success feedback, and CTA copy need follow-ups.

Samir Patel: I can repro the focus jump. When you open the approve modal, focus lands on the first checkbox in the list instead of the modal container. Screen reader keeps reading background items.

Jia Li: Sounds like the modal doesn't have a proper focus trap / role=dialog setup. Proposal for tab order: header (close) -> primary CTA (Approve) -> reason input -> list -> secondary actions. That way Enter can trigger approve predictably. Also please add a visible focus ring in dense/compact modes.

Oliver Grant: Copy nit: current CTA says `Approve results` — product question: should we use `Approve run` or `Approve all`? Which maps best to user mental model?

Nina (Design): I prefer `Approve run` since it's scoped to the run object, but worried about confusion with per-test approvals in other screens. Suggest small clarifying helper text: `Approves all examples in this run.`

Leo (Product): Leaning toward short label `Approve run`. Keep CTA succinct, put helper text under the CTA for clarity. Longer labels make the affordance heavier in compact layouts.

Jia Li: Accessibility follow-ups: add `role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\"` on the modal root, focus the dialog container with `tabindex=-1` on open, and use `aria-live=\"polite\"` for the post-approve toast. Toast should announce `Run approved — 24 examples` and include an inline `Undo` link that is keyboard reachable.

Maya Chen: UX microinteraction: current flow closes the modal immediately, shows a small toast, and then a skeleton refresh on the parent page. It's easy to miss the confirmation. Suggest we instead keep the modal open and show a success state (green header + inline undo) for 4–6s before auto-closing. That reduces context switching and makes Undo discoverable.

Samir Patel: Implementation note: keeping modal open is straightforward. We can swap the modal body to a success panel and highlight the approved rows with a subtle green outline. I'll add `data-qa` attributes for e2e checks. Also, map Escape to a 'dismiss' only after the undo timer ends to prevent accidental closures.

Nina (Design): Mobile constraint: inline Undo button next to CTA will crowd the row. For narrow widths show `Undo` as a small text link below the CTA instead. Also provide 48px tappable targets.

ux-bot: Accessibility check failed on staging: modal header missing `role=dialog` and `aria-modal=true`. Created issue #1123.

Maya Chen: Thanks @ux-bot — action items: 1) Samir to add focus trap + role=dialog + keyboard undo behavior (due Mon). 2) Jia to prepare copy variants for quick A/B: A: `Approve run`, B: `Approve all` + helper line (due Tue). 3) Nina to mock success state with inline undo + mobile variation (due Wed). I'll schedule a short proto review after changes.

Samir Patel: noted, will push a staging PR with the modal fixes and `data-qa` hooks.

Jia Li: I'll drop copy options in the doc and link the accessibility notes.

Oliver Grant: Fine with `Approve run` + helper text — feel free to ship copy A unless test shows confusion.

Maya Chen: Cool, thanks everyone. Adding :spiral_note_pad: to follow-up thread once PR is up.

Samir Patel: :thumbsup:

Nina (Design): :ok_hand:

Leon (Product): thanks!
